title: Apollo 10's floating turd
caption:
Humanity's greatest mission to the Moon included a mystery nobody ever solved. 💩
In zero gravity nothing falls, so anything you let go of floats until it hits something, which is why modern space toilets use fans.
Who do you think it was?
sources: NASA Apollo 10 onboard voice transcription, May 1969 ("Give me a napkin quick. There's a turd floating through the air.")
NASA, Apollo waste management: fecal bags with an adhesive ring and a germicide pouch; NASA, ISS Universal Waste Management System uses airflow
